title: Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman to headline OpenText World 2026
summary: Join us at OpenText World 2026 in Orlando October 19-22 to be inspired by our featured guest speaker Commander Reid Wiseman of Artemis II.
body_markdown:
What does it take to lead one of the most ambitious missions of our time?


Find out at[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?hp-link=true&_gl=1*wxxi8i*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mi4xMjI5MzMwNzI1LjE3ODkwNjI0ODAuMTc4OTA2MjQ4MC4xMjAzODc2ODg4LjE3ODkwNjI0ODAuMTc4OTA2MjQ4MA..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODkzOTE2NDQkbzE5JGcxJHQxNzg5Mzk5MTEwJGo2MCRsMCRoMjA4NTI4MzI1OA..) where Reid Wiseman, NASA astronaut and commander of the Artemis II mission, joins us as a special guest speaker. As the commander of the first crewed mission to travel around the moon since Apollo 17, Wiseman operates at the intersection of human ingenuity, advanced technology, data-driven decision-making, and exploration.


## Innovation at the edge of what’s possible


For this successful mission, Wiseman and the Artemis II crew relied on advanced systems, real-time information, rigorous testing, and seamless collaboration between thousands of scientists, engineers, and mission specialists.


The Artemis program represents one of the most sophisticated technology initiatives ever, bringing together advancements in spacecraft systems, communications, data analysis, automation, and human-machine interaction. The mission demonstrates how innovation and information can help people solve complex problems, adapt to changing conditions, and achieve outcomes once thought impossible.


Photo Credit: NASA/Bill Ingalls


For organizations navigating their own transformation journeys, Wiseman’s experiences offer a unique perspective on turning vast amounts of information into action when the stakes are high and uncertainty is constant.


## Join us for an inspiring keynote


Don’t miss this opportunity to hear how Wiseman leveraged information to navigate uncertainty and achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll come away with a deeper understanding of what’s possible using technology, perseverance, and human ingenuity.


OpenText World 2026 takes place in Orlando, October 19-22. Register by September 22 and save $200.
